resize_observation_shortest_edge: create a ResizeShortestEdge transformer to resize RGB and depth observation images to a target shortest edge size
center_crop_observations: create a CenterCropper transformer to center crop RGB and depth observation images to a fixed height and width
convert_cubemap_to_equirect: create a CubeMap2Equirect transformer to stitch six cubemap camera sensors into a single equirectangular 360 degree image
convert_cubemap_to_fisheye: create a CubeMap2Fisheye transformer to stitch six cubemap camera sensors into a fisheye image with configurable FOV and camera parameters
apply_obs_transforms_batch: call apply_obs_transforms_batch to sequentially apply a list of registered observation transformers to a batched observation dictionary
